content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The geographic exclusion that creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh face from conventional payment platforms is systemic, not incidental. PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy all operate within the traditional financial system, subject to the same correspondent banking relationships and AML compliance requirements that make international money movement difficult in certain corridors. Blockchain-based payments operate outside this system entirely. A USDT transaction from a buyer in Germany to a seller in Lagos does not pass through any correspondent bank. It does not require a compliance officer to approve the transaction corridor. It settles peer-to-peer, on-chain, in under 60 seconds.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your sovereign digital store, you must first identify the tools that will form your commerce stack. Start with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your website. Choose Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. For your order storage, Supabase or Google Sheets will suffice. Finally, ensure you have access to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This foundation allows you to easily integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

After establishing your infrastructure, the next step is setting up your payment and delivery systems. Create an account with NOWPayments to start accepting cryptocurrency payments, such as USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. Link your payment processor to your backend logic, ensuring that transaction confirmations trigger automatic product delivery from your storage solution. This workflow guarantees a smooth purchase experience for your customers.
Own your infrastructure and eliminate reliance on external platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is configured, it’s time to go live. Test your payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly before launching. Start with a small group of trusted users to process your first transactions, ensuring every step from payment to delivery functions seamlessly. Solicit feedback to refine your process, thus ensuring that your customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation, solidifying trust in your platform.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products to international buyers by utilizing blockchain payment systems and decentralized infrastructure. Platforms like NOWPayments allow you to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, facilitating transactions without the need for conventional payment gateways. This approach enables creators to reach global audiences without being hindered by local restrictions.
Blockchain payments empower creators to operate without barriers.

Choose a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for orders. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivering files. Sign up for NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments. Test your entire system before launching to ensure everything works smoothly.
